name: Yash Modi
about:
Yash Modi has loved soccer since he was a toddler. He was always curious and always outside, especially when there was a ball nearby, and he started playing at the age of three. Summer camps came next, and year after year he has grown into a confident, hard-working player.

Today Yash wears jersey #38 for Peninsula Arsenal White in the U10 group, playing in the 2026-27 NorCal Premier Fall season. He plays as a striker and on both wings, as a right and left midfielder.

Off the soccer field, Yash is an all-round athlete. He loves skiing, swimming, ice-skating, volleyball, cricket and badminton. But soccer will always be his first love.
footer: Made with love by his #1 fan — Mom ⚽
otherSports: Skiing, swimming, ice-skating, volleyball, cricket, badminton
